The animated illustrations on the landing page: `LiveBuild` (a simulated build that starts after the hero intro), and the Code, Dag, Graph, Trace, Review, Workspaces and Chat visuals, plus `Reveal`.

- Each visual is a self-contained SVG or HTML mock with its own timers.
